info.title: Camu API
info.description:
# Camu API Documentation

Welcome to the Camu API - a comprehensive, developer-centric RESTful interface for managing Brazilian Documentos Fiscais Eletrônicos (NFe, CTe, NFSe, etc.) within the CAMU platform.

## Overview

The Camu API provides programmatic access to:
- **Electronic Tax Documents (DFes)**: Query, retrieve, and manage NFe, CTe, and NFSe documents
- **Companies**: Access company information within your tenant
- **Users**: Manage user accounts in bulk
- **File Uploads**: Upload and process electronic fiscal documents

## Authentication

All API endpoints require authentication via an API key. Include your API key in the `x-api-key` header of every request:

```
x-api-key: your-api-key-here
```

Contact your Camu administrator to obtain an API key for your application.

## Rate Limiting

The API enforces the following rate limits:
- **Rate Limit**: 100 requests per second
- **Burst Limit**: 500 requests

## Error Handling

The API uses standard HTTP status codes to indicate success or failure:

- **200 OK**: Request successful
- **400 Bad Request**: Invalid input or validation error
- **401 Unauthorized**: Missing or invalid API key
- **404 Not Found**: Resource not found
- **500 Internal Server Error**: Server-side error

Error responses include a JSON body with details:

```json
{
  "error": "Detailed error message"
}
```

## Pagination

List endpoints support offset-based pagination:
- Use the `limit` query parameter to specify the maximum number of results (1-100, default: 100)
- Use the `offset` query parameter to skip results
- The response includes `nextOffset` and `nextUrl` fields when more results are available

## Field Filtering

List endpoints support field filtering via the `fields` query parameter:
- Specify comma-separated field names to return only those fields
- Example: `fields=documentType,documentKey,documentNumber`
- If not specified, all fields are returned (except `xmlContent` which must be explicitly requested)

## Base URLs

- **Production**: `https://api.service.camu.com.br`
- **Staging**: `https://api.staging.camu.com.br`

tags.name: dfes
tags.description:
Operations for managing Documentos Fiscais Eletrônicos (DFes).

**Supported Document Types:**

| Document Type | List | Get | XML | PDF | Events | Upload |
|---------------|------|-----|-----|-----|--------|--------|
| **NFe** (Nota Fiscal Eletrônica) | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ DANFE | ✓ | ✓ |
| **CTe** (Conhecimento de Transporte Eletrônico) | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ DACTE | ✓ | ✓ |
| **CT-e OS** (Conhecimento de Transporte Eletrônico OS) | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ DACTE-OS | ✓ | ✓ |
| **NFSe** (Nota Fiscal de Serviços Eletrônica) | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ DANFSE | ✓ | Via sync |

**Note on NFSe:** NFSe documents are automatically synced from municipal systems via the NFSe Nacional integration. They can be queried like any other DFe type.

**Document Events:** Events represent post-issuance actions on documents. NFe supports manifestações (ConfirmOperation, AcknowledgeReceipt, UnknownOperation, OperationNotPerformed), corrections, and cancellations. CTe additionally supports delivery events (DeliveryNote, DeliverySuccess, DeliveryFailed) and MDF-e linkage events.

Each document has a unique access key (chave de acesso) that serves as its primary identifier.

tags.name: companies
tags.description:
Operations for managing companies within your CAMU tenant.

Companies represent legal entities (with CNPJ) that issue or receive electronic fiscal documents.

tags.name: files
tags.description:
Operations for uploading and processing files.

File upload endpoints allow you to submit electronic fiscal documents (XML format) for processing and storage in the CAMU system.

**Supported document types for upload:**
- NFe (Nota Fiscal Eletrônica)
- CTe (Conhecimento de Transporte Eletrônico)

**Note:** NFSe documents are ingested via the NFSe Nacional integration, not through this upload endpoint.

tags.name: webhooks
tags.description:
Webhook notifications sent by Camu to your registered endpoints.

Webhooks provide real-time notifications when events occur in your tenant,
enabling event-driven integrations without polling.

**Supported Events:**
- `captured` - New document captured
- `canceled` - Document canceled
- `validation_succeed` - Validation passed
- `validation_failed` - Validation failed
- `manifestation` - Manifestation event received

tags.name: audit
tags.description:
Audit log endpoints for tracking changes to settings and other audited resources.

Entries record the old and new values, which fields changed, who made the change, and when.

get.description:
Retrieves a paginated list of DFe summaries for the authenticated tenant.

This endpoint returns DFe objects. Use the `fields` parameter to control which fields are returned.

**Supported Document Types**:
- `nfe`: Nota Fiscal Eletrônica
- `cte`: Conhecimento de Transporte Eletrônico
- `cte-os`: Conhecimento de Transporte Eletrônico OS
- `nfse`: Nota Fiscal de Serviços Eletrônica

**Field Filtering**: Use the `fields` parameter to specify which fields to return. The `xmlContent` field is only returned when explicitly requested.

**Pagination**: Results are returned in pages. Use `nextOffset` and `nextUrl` from the response to fetch the next page.

parameters.name: documentType
parameters.description: The type of electronic fiscal document to list.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of items to return per page

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description:
Number of items to skip before starting to return results.

Use the `nextOffset` value from the previous response to retrieve subsequent pages.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description:
Comma-separated list of fields to return.

Available fields: `documentType`, `documentKey`, `documentNumber`, `documentSeries`, `emissionDate`, `manifestationStatus`, `documentStatus`, `erpDocumentStatus`, `content`, `xmlContent`

If not specified, all fields except `xmlContent` are returned. The `xmlContent` field must be explicitly requested.

**Note**: Requesting `xmlContent` will fetch the raw XML from storage for each document, which may impact response time.

parameters.name: document_status
parameters.description:
Filter documents by validation status. Accepts comma-separated values for multiple statuses.

**Allowed values**:
- `captured`: Documents that have been captured but not yet processed
- `in_review`: Documents currently under review
- `approved`: Documents that have been approved
- `errors`: Documents with validation errors
- `canceled`: Documents that have been canceled

**Example**: `document_status=approved,canceled` returns only approved and canceled documents.

parameters.name: manifestation_status
parameters.description:
Filter documents by manifestation status (NFe only). Accepts comma-separated values for multiple statuses.

**Allowed values**:
- `acknowledgement_of_issuance`: Ciência da Emissão - Recipient has acknowledged the document
- `confirmation_of_operation`: Confirmação da Operação - Operation confirmed by recipient
- `operation_unknown`: Desconhecimento da Operação - Recipient is unaware of the operation
- `operation_not_performed`: Operação não Realizada - Operation was not performed
- `executing`: Manifestação em processamento - Manifestation is being processed

**Example**: `manifestation_status=confirmation_of_operation` returns only documents with confirmed operations.

**Note**: This filter is most relevant for NFe documents. Other document types may not have manifestation statuses.

parameters.name: issue_date_start
parameters.description:
Filter documents issued on or after this date (inclusive).
Format: `YYYY-MM-DD` (ISO 8601 date).

**Example**: `issue_date_start=2025-01-01` returns documents issued from January 1, 2025.

parameters.name: issue_date_end
parameters.description:
Filter documents issued on or before this date (inclusive).
Format: `YYYY-MM-DD` (ISO 8601 date).

**Example**: `issue_date_end=2025-12-31` returns documents issued up to December 31, 2025.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description:
Sort order for the results. Format: `field:direction`.

**Available fields**:
- `issue_date`: Sort by document issue/emission date
- `captured_at`: Sort by the date the document was captured into the system

**Directions**: `asc` (ascending, oldest first) or `desc` (descending, newest first).
If direction is omitted, defaults to `desc`.

**Examples**:
- `sort=issue_date:desc` — newest issue dates first
- `sort=captured_at:asc` — oldest captures first

nfseList.summary: NFSe documents list (synced via NFSe Nacional)

get.description:
Retrieves a paginated list of events across all documents of a specific type for the authenticated tenant.

This endpoint provides a unified view of events across all documents, useful for building
event-driven integrations and audit logs. Only allowlisted event types are returned.

**Currently exposed event types:**
| Document Type | Event Types |
|---------------|-------------|
| `nfe` | `Cancel` (Cancelamento), `Approved` (Validation approved), `ValidationFailed` (Validation failed) |
| `cte` | _(none yet)_ |
| `cte-os` | _(none yet)_ |
| `nfse` | _(none yet)_ |

**Pagination:** Uses cursor-based pagination with UUIDv7 IDs:
1. First request: `GET /{documentType}/events?limit=50`
2. Check `has_more` in response to see if more events exist
3. If `has_more` is true, use `next_cursor` for the next request: `GET /{documentType}/events?cursor={next_cursor}&limit=50`
4. Repeat until `has_more` is false

parameters.name: documentType
parameters.description: The type of electronic fiscal document.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description:
Cursor for pagination (UUIDv7 format).

Use the `next_cursor` value from a previous response to fetch the next page.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description:
Maximum number of events to return per page.

Defaults to 50 if not specified.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description:
Filter events by source.

- `camu`: Events generated by the Camu platform
- `sefaz`: Events from the Brazilian tax authority

parameters.name: event_type
parameters.description:
Filter events by event type(s). Comma-separated list of event type values.

Only events matching the specified types (and within the allowlisted types for the document type) are returned.

**NFe event types:** `Cancel`, `Approved`, `ValidationFailed`, `Captured`, `Emitted`

parameters.name: tax_id
parameters.description:
Filter events by company CNPJ(s). Comma-separated list of 14-digit CNPJs.

Each CNPJ must belong to the authenticated tenant; returns 400 if any are not found.

eventsWithMore.summary: Events list with more pages available

get.description:
Retrieves a specific event by its unique identifier.

Use this endpoint to fetch the full details of an event when you have its ID,
for example from a webhook notification or from the events list.

**Security:** Only events belonging to the authenticated tenant can be accessed.
Attempting to access events from other tenants will return 404 Not Found.

parameters.name: documentType
parameters.description:
The type of electronic fiscal document.

**Note:** Currently only `nfe` is supported. Support for `cte` and `nfse` is planned.

parameters.name: eventId
parameters.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the event

post.description:
Acknowledges that an event has been successfully processed by the client.

**Security:** Only events belonging to the authenticated tenant can be acknowledged.
Attempting to acknowledge events from other tenants will return 403 Forbidden.

> **Note:** This endpoint is **optional** for event polling integrations. When using the
> `GET /{documentType}/events` endpoint, you can simply track the last processed checkpoint
> on your side. However, this endpoint is **important for webhook integrations** where Camu
> pushes events to your system - acknowledging events confirms successful delivery and
> prevents retries.

**When to use:**
- **Event polling:** Optional - you can manage checkpoints client-side
- **Webhook integrations:** Recommended - confirms event delivery and stops retries

**Idempotency:**
Acknowledging the same event ID multiple times is safe and will return success.

parameters.name: documentType
parameters.description:
The type of electronic fiscal document.

**Note:** Currently only `nfe` is supported. Support for `cte` and `nfse` is planned.

parameters.name: eventId
parameters.description:
The unique identifier (UUID) of the event to acknowledge.

This is the event ID from the events list response.

value.error: Invalid eventId: must be a valid UUID

403.description: Forbidden - Event belongs to a different tenant

value.error: Forbidden: Event does not belong to your tenant

get.description:
Retrieves all events associated with a specific DFe document.

Events represent actions that occurred on the document after its issuance.

**NFe Event Types:**
| tpEvento | eventType | Description |
|----------|-----------|-------------|
| 110110 | Correction | Carta de Correção Eletrônica (CCe) |
| 110111 | Cancel | Document cancellation |
| 210200 | ConfirmOperation | Confirmação da Operação (recipient confirms) |
| 210210 | AcknowledgeReceipt | Ciência da Operação (recipient acknowledges) |
| 210220 | UnknownOperation | Desconhecimento da Operação (recipient doesn't recognize) |
| 210240 | OperationNotPerformed | Operação não Realizada (operation not performed) |

**CTe Event Types:**
| tpEvento | eventType | Description |
|----------|-----------|-------------|
| - | Authorized | CTe authorization event |
| 110110 | Correction | Carta de Correção Eletrônica |
| 110111 | Cancel | Document cancellation |
| 110180 | DeliveryNote | Comprovante de Entrega (delivery note) |
| 110181 | CancelDeliveryNote | Cancelamento do Comprovante de Entrega |
| 110190 | DeliveryFailed | Insucesso na Entrega (delivery failed) |
| 110191 | DeliverySuccess | Entrega Realizada (delivery success) |
| 310610 | AuthorizedMDFe | MDF-e Autorizado (linked to authorized MDF-e) |
| 310611 | CancelMDFe | MDF-e Cancelado (linked MDF-e cancelled) |

**NFSe Event Types:**
| eventType | Description |
|-----------|-------------|
| CANCELAMENTO | NFSe cancellation |
| CANCELAMENTO_DEFERIDO_ANALISE_FISCAL | Cancellation approved after fiscal analysis |
| CANCELAMENTO_POR_SUBSTITUICAO | Cancellation by substitution |
| CONFIRMACAO_TOMADOR | Service taker confirmation |
| SOLICITACAO_CANCELAMENTO_ANALISE_FISCAL | Cancellation request under fiscal analysis |

**Note**: Not all documents have events. A newly issued document that hasn't been manifested or corrected will return an empty events array.

Returns the auxiliary document as a PDF file.

**Supported Document Types:**
- **NFe**: Returns DANFE (Documento Auxiliar da Nota Fiscal Eletrônica) ✓
- **CTe**: Returns DACTE (Documento Auxiliar do Conhecimento de Transporte Eletrônico) ✓

**Response Format**: The response is a Base64-encoded PDF string. Decode it to get the binary PDF file.

**Use Cases**:
- Printing shipping documents
- Generating delivery receipts
- Customer documentation

get.description:
Retrieves all companies associated with the authenticated tenant.

Companies represent legal entities (identified by CNPJ) that issue or receive electronic fiscal documents within your tenant's scope.

**Note**: This endpoint returns all companies without pagination.

post.description:
Uploads one or more electronic fiscal document files (XML format) for processing.

This endpoint accepts multipart/form-data requests containing XML files representing Brazilian electronic fiscal documents (NFe, CTe, NFSe, CC-e).

**Processing Flow**:
1. Files are validated as XML documents
2. Document type is identified (NFe, CTe, NFSe, or CC-e)
3. Document key is extracted to check for duplicates
4. Company matching is performed (see Company Matching below)
5. Documents are stored in S3 (path: `nfe-documents/`, `cte-documents/`, `nfse-documents/`, or `cce-documents/`)
6. Processing workflow is triggered asynchronously

**File Requirements**:
- Format: XML (valid NFe, CTe, NFSe Nacional, or CC-e structure)
- Content-Type: application/xml or text/xml
- Maximum file size: 5MB per file
- Multiple files can be uploaded in a single request using the `files` field

**Company Matching (CNPJ Resolution Order)**:
The system attempts to match the document to companies in your tenant using CNPJs in this order.

For **NFe** documents:
1. **Destination CNPJ** (`dest`) - The recipient of the document
2. **Transporter CNPJ** (`transp`) - The freight carrier
3. **Emit CNPJ** (`emit`) - The issuer of the document

For **CTe** documents:
1. **Tomador CNPJ** (`toma`/`dest`/`rem`) - The payer for the freight service
2. **Emit CNPJ** (`emit`) - The issuer of the document

For **NFSe** documents (service invoices — no transporter concept):
1. **Tomador CNPJ** (`DPS.infDPS.toma`) - The service taker / recipient
2. **Prestador CNPJ** (`DPS.infDPS.prest`) - The service provider / issuer

For **CC-e** documents (Carta de Correção Eletrônica — a correction event on an NFe):
- The company is resolved from the **parent NFe** that the CC-e references (same access key, document type NFe).
- The parent NFe **must already exist** in your tenant. If it does not, the CC-e is reported with
  `cceOutcome: parent_not_found` and is not processed (upload the NFe before its CC-e).

Documents are only fully processed if a matching company is found in your tenant.

**Duplicate Detection**:
- Before uploading, the system checks if a document with the same key already exists
- If found, `alreadyExists: true` is returned and the document is not re-processed
- The existing `storagePath` is returned for reference

**CC-e / Unsupported Outcomes** (`cceOutcome`):
- `imported` - CC-e stored and its import workflow was triggered
- `already_exists` - CC-e was already stored (not re-processed)
- `parent_not_found` - the referenced parent NFe is not present in your tenant
- `unsupported` - the file was not a recognized fiscal document type
- `errored` - the CC-e could not be processed due to an error

post.description:
> **🚧 Not Implemented** - This webhook is planned but not yet available.

Camu sends this webhook to your registered URL when a new event occurs.

**Setup:**
To receive webhooks, contact Camu support to register your endpoint URL.
Your endpoint must:
- Accept POST requests
- Respond with 2xx status within 30 seconds
- Handle duplicate deliveries (use `id` for idempotency)

**Retry Policy:**
Failed deliveries are retried with exponential backoff:
- 1st retry: 1 minute
- 2nd retry: 5 minutes
- 3rd retry: 30 minutes
- Final retry: 2 hours

**Security:**
Each webhook includes a signature header (`X-Camu-Signature`) for verification.
Validate this signature using your webhook secret before processing.

**Acknowledgment:**
After successfully processing the event, call `POST /{documentType}/events/{eventId}/ack`
to confirm receipt and stop retries.

DfeSummary.description: DFe summary object used in list responses

documentType.description: The type of electronic fiscal document

documentKey.description:
The access key (chave de acesso).

This is the unique identifier for the electronic tax document issued by the Brazilian tax authorities.

documentNumber.description:
The sequential document number (número da nota/conhecimento).

This is the invoice number assigned by the issuer.

documentSeries.description:
The document series (série do documento).

A number between 1-999 that identifies the document series.

emissionDate.description:
The date and time when the document was issued (data de emissão).

Format: ISO 8601 with timezone.

manifestationStatus.description:
The manifestation status of the document (NFe only).

**Values:**
- `acknowledgement_of_issuance`: Ciência da Emissão - Recipient acknowledges awareness of the invoice
- `confirmation_of_operation`: Confirmação da Operação - Recipient confirms the operation took place
- `operation_unknown`: Desconhecimento da Operação - Recipient does not recognize the operation
- `operation_not_performed`: Operação não Realizada - Operation was not performed
- `executing`: Manifestação em Execução - Manifestation is being processed

documentStatus.description:
The validation status of the document in the Camu system.

**Values:**
- `captured`: Document was captured but not yet reviewed
- `in_review`: Document is under review
- `approved`: Document passed validation
- `errors`: Document has validation errors
- `canceled`: Document was canceled
- `pending_approval`: Automated validation finished, awaiting user approval

erpDocumentStatus.description:
The status of the document in the ERP (e.g., SAP B1, Oracle NetSuite).

This is independent of `documentStatus` (which reflects validation/review in Camu) and tracks the document's lifecycle in the customer's ERP.

**Values:**
- `no_purchase_order_required`: The document does not require an associated purchase order
- `purchase_order_found`: A matching purchase order was found in the ERP
- `purchase_order_not_found`: No matching purchase order could be found in the ERP
- `purchase_delivery_draft_in_erp`: A draft purchase delivery (goods receipt) exists in the ERP
- `purchase_delivery_posted_in_erp`: The purchase delivery (goods receipt) was posted in the ERP
- `purchase_invoice_draft_in_erp`: A draft purchase invoice exists in the ERP
- `purchase_invoice_posted_in_erp`: The purchase invoice was posted in the ERP
- `canceled_in_erp`: The document was canceled in the ERP
- `credit_note_posted_in_erp`: A credit note was posted in the ERP
- `credit_note_draft_in_erp`: A credit note draft was created in the ERP
- `sales_invoice_found`: Return NF-e — the sales invoice it returns was found in the ERP
- `sales_invoice_not_found`: Return NF-e — the sales invoice it returns was not found in the ERP
- `not_applicable`: ERP posting does not apply to this document
- `pending`: ERP processing has not yet started
- `integration_error`: An error occurred while integrating the document with the ERP

Indicates whether a matching company was found in your tenant for this document.

Documents are only fully processed if a company match is found.

alreadyExists.description:
Indicates whether the document already exists in the database.

If `true`, the document was not processed again (duplicate detection).

documentKey.description:
The 44-character access key (chave de acesso) extracted from the DFe document.

Only present for valid DFe documents.

storagePath.description:
The S3 storage path where the document was uploaded.

Only present for successfully processed DFes or existing documents.

cceOutcome.description:
Outcome for CC-e (Carta de Correção Eletrônica) files and unrecognized files.

Only present on the CC-e path or when a file could not be recognized as a fiscal document.
NFe/CTe/NFSe files do not set this field.

uploadResult.description:
Result of the upload operation (only present for successfully processed DFes).

Content varies based on the processing result.

next_cursor.description:
Cursor to fetch the next page of events (UUIDv7 format).

Pass this value as the `cursor` query parameter to retrieve the next page.
This field is null when there are no more events.

The cursor is a UUIDv7 which encodes the timestamp of the last event,
ensuring consistent ordering and efficient pagination.

event_content.description:
Event-specific content and metadata.

The structure varies based on event type:
- `captured`: Object with capturedBy, source info
- `canceled`: Object with cancellation reason, protocol
- `validation_succeed/validation_failed`: Array of line items with validation results (see below)
- `manifestation`: Object with tpEvento, xEvento, protocol details

**Validation content structure (validation_succeed/validation_failed):**
```json
[
  {
    "lineNumber": 1,
    "classification": {
      "cfop": 1565,
      "classification": "Uso consumo"
    },
    "validations": [
      {
        "type": "ICMS",
        "result": "approved"
      },
      {
        "type": "IPI",
        "result": "error",
        "message": "ICMS Divergente"
      }
    ]
  }
]
```

Each line item contains:
- `lineNumber`: The document line number
- `classification`: CFOP code and classification description
- `validations`: Array of validation results per tax type (ICMS, IPI, etc.)
  - `type`: Tax type being validated
  - `result`: `"approved"` or `"error"`
  - `message`: Error message (only present when result is `"error"`)

eventType.description:
Human-readable event type name. Values vary by document type.

**NFe event types:**
- `Correction` - Carta de Correção Eletrônica (tpEvento: 110110)
- `Cancel` - Document cancellation (tpEvento: 110111)
- `ConfirmOperation` - Confirmação da Operação (tpEvento: 210200)
- `AcknowledgeReceipt` - Ciência da Operação (tpEvento: 210210)
- `UnknownOperation` - Desconhecimento da Operação (tpEvento: 210220)
- `OperationNotPerformed` - Operação não Realizada (tpEvento: 210240)

**CTe/CT-e OS event types:**
- `Authorized` - CTe authorization event
- `Correction` - Carta de Correção Eletrônica (tpEvento: 110110)
- `Cancel` - Document cancellation (tpEvento: 110111)
- `DeliveryNote` - Comprovante de Entrega (tpEvento: 110180)
- `CancelDeliveryNote` - Cancelamento do Comprovante (tpEvento: 110181)
- `DeliveryFailed` - Insucesso na Entrega (tpEvento: 110190)
- `DeliverySuccess` - Entrega Realizada (tpEvento: 110191)
- `AuthorizedMDFe` - MDF-e Autorizado (tpEvento: 310610)
- `CancelMDFe` - MDF-e Cancelado (tpEvento: 310611)

**NFSe event types:**
- `Document` - Documento NFSe (eventTypeCode: NFSE)
- `Cancel` - NFSe cancellation (eventTypeCode: CANCELAMENTO)
- `CancelBySubstitution` - Cancellation by substitution (eventTypeCode: CANCELAMENTO_POR_SUBSTITUICAO)
- `CancelApprovedFiscalAnalysis` - Cancellation approved after fiscal analysis
- `ServiceTakerConfirmation` - Service taker confirmation (eventTypeCode: CONFIRMACAO_TOMADOR)

May be null if the event type could not be determined.

eventTypeCode.description:
Raw event type code (tpEvento) from Sefaz or municipal systems.

**NFe Codes:**
- `110110` - Carta de Correção Eletrônica (CCe)
- `110111` - Cancelamento
- `210200` - Confirmação da Operação
- `210210` - Ciência da Emissão
- `210220` - Desconhecimento da Operação
- `210240` - Operação não Realizada

**CTe/CT-e OS Codes:**
- `110110` - Carta de Correção
- `110111` - Cancelamento
- `110180` - Comprovante de Entrega
- `110181` - Cancelamento do Comprovante de Entrega
- `110190` - Insucesso na Entrega
- `110191` - Entrega Realizada
- `310610` - MDF-e Autorizado
- `310611` - MDF-e Cancelado

**NFSe Codes (string-based):**
- `NFSE` - Documento NFSe
- `CANCELAMENTO` - Cancelamento
- `CANCELAMENTO_POR_SUBSTITUICAO` - Cancelamento por Substituição
- `CONFIRMACAO_TOMADOR` - Confirmação do Tomador

eventCategory.description:
Category of the event for easier filtering and classification.

**Values:**
- `document` - Document-related event (authorization, etc.)
- `canceled` - Cancellation event
- `manifestation` - Recipient manifestation (NFe: Ciência, Confirmação, etc.)
- `delivery` - Delivery-related event (CTe: Comprovante de Entrega, etc.)
- `correction` - Correction letter (CCe)
- `validation` - Validation event (Approved, ValidationFailed)
- `other` - Other event types

eventContent.description:
Complete parsed XML content of the event in JSON format.

The structure varies based on document and event type. Common structures include:

**NFe events** (`procEventoNFe.evento.infEvento`):
- Manifestação: `tpEvento`, `xEvento`, `dhEvento`
- Cancelamento: `tpEvento`, `xEvento`, `xJust` (justification)
- CCe: `tpEvento`, `xEvento`, `xCorrecao` (correction text)

**CTe events**:
- Authorization (`cteProc.protCTe.infProt`): `cStat`, `xMotivo`, `dhRecbto`
- Other events (`procEventoCTe.evento.infEvento`): `tpEvento`, `xEvento`, `dhEvento`
- MDF-e linkage: `tpEvento`, `xEvento`, `chMDFe` (MDF-e key)

**NFSe events**:
- Cancelamento: `codigoCancelamento`, `motivoCancelamento`
- Confirmação: `dataConfirmacao`, `statusConfirmacao`

Refer to SEFAZ/municipal documentation for complete event schemas.
